# Why is static IK not sufficient in whole-body manipulation?

> **Current answer:** Static IK only indicates that a certain posture may have a joint solution, but does not necessarily satisfy task conditions and dynamic reachability. This post constructs a dynamic reachability map by sampling 20 million trajectories and postures per arm, and verifies it with an IK solver; however, there is no real-world result, so it is only a candidate method.
